setup: The linearization at \(a\) is the tangent line, \(L(x) = f(a) + f'(a)(x - a)\).

steps.say: Evaluate the function at the point: \(f([[a]]) = [[fa]]\).
Differentiate: \(f'(x) = [[fprime]]\), so the slope at \(x = [[a]]\) is \(f'([[a]]) = [[m]]\).
Put both into the tangent line: \(L(x) = [[fa]] + [[m_p]]([[shift]]) = [[line]]\).
The tangent line at \([[kk]]\) gives \(L([[n]]) = [[k]] + \frac{[[d]]}{[[two_k]]} = [[root_est]]\), slightly above the true root because the square root is concave.
